description.value: Askew's Foods is a locally owned, family-operated supermarket chain founded in 1929, with its Sicamous location serving as a key resupply point at the junction of the Trans-Canada Highway and Highway 97A. The store runs full departments including bakery, deli, meat, and produce, staffed by named department managers. Grocery delivery to local accommodations is also available by phone or email.

enrichment_extras.reasoning: The website for the Sicamous location confirms the OSM address (436 Main Street, Sicamous BC V0E 2V0) and provides a phone number ((250) 836-4899) absent from the OSM record. The store is clearly an active, full-service supermarket evidenced by OSM tag shop=supermarket and website listings of bakery, deli, meat, and produce department managers. No cycling-specific amenities (bike parking, water refill, etc.) are mentioned in either the OSM tags or website content.
concerns: OSM record contains no phone number; (250) 836-4899 sourced from website only.
enrichment_extras.recommended_status_reason: Askew's Foods is an active full-service supermarket in Sicamous with comprehensive grocery departments, making it a clear and valuable resupply stop for touring cyclists.
